title: Bystander on the Fence: Sanctions in a Multipolar World
abstract: arXiv:2610.22830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We provide a theory of optimal trade sanctions with three strategic players: Home (sanctioner), Foreign (target), and Bystander. Bystander may act unilaterally or ally with either party subject to a participation constraint. We derive three novel results. First, members of a coalition generically set different tariffs either under Stackelberg timing or when transfers are imperfect. Second, as sanctions tighten, Home's welfare can improve even beyond the unilateral terms-of-trade optimum due to strategic interactions. Third, we characterize feasible sanctions targets when Home and Foreign compete for Bystander's support. An alternative implementation arises with competition: Home lets Foreign win, but Foreign's transfer to Bystander implements the sanctions target. translated_title: 观望中的旁观者：多极世界中的制裁
translated_abstract: 我们构建了一个关于最优贸易制裁的理论，其中包含三个策略参与者：本国（制裁方）、外国（被制裁目标）与旁观者。旁观者可以单方面行动，或在满足参与约束的条件下与任何一方结盟。我们得出了三项新颖结论。第一，联盟成员通常会在斯塔克尔伯格时序下或当转移支付不完全时设定不同的关税。第二，随着制裁收紧，由于策略互动的存在，本国的福利可以改善，甚至超过单边贸易条件最优水平。第三，我们刻画了当本国与外国竞争争取旁观者支持时的可行制裁目标。在竞争情形下出现了一种替代实施方案：本国让外国“获胜”，但外国向旁观者的转移支付实现了制裁目标。我们将该模型应用于针对俄罗斯原油的制裁。在校准分析中，印度、中国与俄罗斯之间的合作最能匹配观测数据。制裁本可以……
tldr: 本文构建了制裁方、被制裁方与旁观者三方博弈下的最优贸易制裁理论，得出联盟成员会设定差异化关税、制裁收紧可使制裁方福利超越单边贸易条件最优等新结论，并以对俄原油制裁进行校准，发现印中俄合作最能解释实际数据。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of optimal trade sanctions in a three-player game between sanctioner, target, and bystander, deriving novel results that coalition members set differentiated tariffs and that sanctions can improve the sanctioner's welfare beyond the unilateral terms-of-trade optimum, with calibration to Russian crude sanctions showing India-China-Russia cooperation best matches observed data.
